name: LongCat Avatar 1.5 (q8)
about: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 (13.6B, 8-bit DiT, 8 DMD steps), experimental MLX port: head and body motion from a portrait and speech; very slow (~10 min per second of video at 256×432, sizes scaled down to that area)

defaults.prompt: A person talks to the camera with natural facial expressions, the lips move in sync with the speech, subtle head movement, steady camera
